name: Mos Le'Harmless
accessNote: Requires Cabin Fever to reach the island. About 50 Jungle horror spawns roam the surface, densest in the camp north of the cave exit; walls, plants, and trees provide safespots. Multicombat and cannon-placement status of the surface are unverified on the wiki, so both default to false. Jungle horrors are not cannon-immune and the island surface is not a prohibited area, so a cannon can be used (single-combat).
